holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the June 2026 quarter reached ₹16,276 crore on revenue of ₹52,241 crore.
The bank received a GST show-cause notice on September 30, 2026, demanding ₹229.14 crore alongside interest and penalties.
Anup Bagchi stepped down as ICICI Prudential Life MD & CEO effective October 13, 2026, succeeded by Sidharatha Mishra.

expected.text: Nomura projected 17% core PPOP growth for the bank ahead of Q2 results.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank represents 10.15% of the fund; despite a -3.30% 3-month return, it remains the fund's largest single asset, anchoring the 35.6% financials allocation.

watch.text: Resolution of the ₹229.14 crore GST show-cause notice and implementation of the SAT order concerning secretarial records.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit stood at ₹20,383 crore for the June 2026 quarter on revenue of ₹90,575 crore.
Advances reached ₹33,075 billion and deposits stood at ₹33,275 billion as of September 2026.
Anup Bagchi was appointed MD & CEO for a three-year term beginning October 27, 2026.
Foreign institutional investors reduced their holding by 2.4% during the September quarter.

expected.text: Nomura estimated core PPOP growth of 17% for major private lenders including HDFC Bank in Q2.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 9.44% fund weight, HDFC Bank was the fund's top detractor over 3 months (-14.27% return, estimated -1.347% contribution drag).

watch.text: The executive transition as Anup Bagchi takes over executive leadership on October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the June 2026 quarter reached ₹7,670 crore on revenue of ₹35,542 crore.
Gross advances grew 23% to ₹13,846 billion and deposits reached ₹14,521 billion as of September 30, 2026.
Senior management personnel Sanjeev Moghe tendered his resignation effective October 30, 2026.

expected.text: Citi and Goldman Sachs projected over 32% upside driven by credit momentum and FCNR-B deposit inflows.

holdings.why_it_matters: Axis Bank constitutes 5.86% of the portfolio, cushioning financial losses as it recorded a 1.66% gain over the last month.

watch.text: Operational continuity following senior manager Sanjeev Moghe's departure at the end of October 2026.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 net profit reached ₹10,012 crore with operating profit margins at 57%.
The company introduced refreshed postpaid plans packaged with annual international roaming on October 8, 2026.
Airtel Business unveiled IQ Gateway, a multi-channel enterprise messaging platform compliant with DPDP rules.
The Department of Telecommunications levied subscriber verification penalties totaling under ₹13 lakh in September and October 2026.

expected.text: Morgan Stanley expected the bundled postpaid plans to reduce subscriber churn, while CLSA expressed a bullish stance.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 5.83% weight, Airtel contributed an estimated -0.35% drag over the last 3 months, reflecting broad pressure across the tech and telecom bucket.

watch.text: Subscriber uptake and enterprise adoption of the newly deployed IQ Gateway platform.

holdings.name: ITC Ltd

what_changed.text: Operating profit fell to ₹5,181 crore with margins at 27% in the June 2026 quarter.
The company bought out the remaining equity of Sproutlife for ₹645 crore on September 28, 2026.
Institutional investor GQG Partners completely exited holdings in ITC during 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: ITC forms 5.06% of the fund and is the core of its 6.4% Consumer Staples allocation, declining -5.59% over 3 months.

watch.text: Operational integration of Yoga Bar manufacturer Sproutlife as a wholly owned subsidiary.

holdings.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 net profit rose to ₹5,998 crore on ₹58,188 crore of sales.
September 2026 sales climbed 15% to 114,874 vehicles, alongside 50,208 tractor units sold.
September overall production rose 19% year-on-year to 121,722 units.
Lightrock Group moved the Competition Commission of India to acquire a stake in Mahindra Last Mile Mobility.

holdings.why_it_matters: Accounting for 5.04% of the portfolio, M&M generated an estimated -0.537% drag over 3 months, being the second largest negative contributor.

watch.text: CCI approval timeline regarding the Lightrock investment in the Last Mile Mobility unit.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 net profit came in at ₹4,988 crore with sales of ₹67,942 crore.
The transmission business won mega EPC orders across Saudi Arabia, UAE, and domestic markets in early October 2026.
The Energy CarbonLite vertical obtained a Limited Notice to Proceed for Jharkhand's 2x800 MW Chandrapura thermal power plant.
The company pushed the completion deadline for divesting its Hyderabad Metro Rail equity to December 31, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: L&T represents 4.77% of the fund and leads the 8.2% Industrials basket, seeing a -6.15% drop over the last 3 months.

watch.text: Execution of the Hyderabad Metro stake sale prior to the revised December 31, 2026 cutoff.

holdings.name: Infosys Ltd

what_changed.text: Revenue reached ₹48,211 crore and net profit stood at ₹7,775 crore in the June 2026 quarter.
The company established an AI research center with Columbia University and expanded its Topaz AI partnership with ABN AMRO.
The US Department of Labor suspended the PERM green card application processing for several Indian IT firms including Infosys.

holdings.why_it_matters: Infosys is 4.52% of the fund and has fallen -20.82% over 6 months, contributing heavily to Technology underperformance.

watch.text: Repercussions of the US PERM program suspension on onsite delivery and talent deployment.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 quarterly profit reached ₹23,196 crore on revenues of ₹309,468 crore.
The firm issued ₹13,008.6 crore in 10-year unsecured NCDs at a 7.90% coupon rate.
CRISIL and CARE affirmed AAA ratings for ₹67,000 crore worth of debentures.

expected.text: European diesel shortages were estimated by BusinessLine to potentially raise Q2 O2C segment earnings by 38% to ₹20,700 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 4.08% weight, Reliance fell -10.51% over 3 months, delivering an estimated -0.429% drag to fund performance.

watch.text: Pricing disclosures and listing procedures for the planned Reliance Jio initial public offering.

holdings.name: Cipla Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 net profit fell to ₹786 crore on an operating margin of 17%.
The Maharashtra FDA cancelled wholesale drug distribution licences at Cipla's Pune warehouse facility.
Cipla signed an exclusive commercial agreement with Qilu for pembrolizumab biosimilar QL2107 in the US.

expected.text: JPMorgan identified Cipla among select pharma picks with an estimated upside potential of up to 25%.

holdings.why_it_matters: Cipla makes up 2.98% of the fund and covers virtually all of its 3% Healthcare exposure, sliding -9.62% over 3 months.

watch.text: Administrative response and regulatory reinstatement concerning the Pune facility distribution licence.

portfolio.statement: Financials concentration and weakness across primary large caps drove a -6.45% decline over the past three months.
interp: The top three negative stock contributions alone subtracted an estimated 2.31% from total fund returns.
Heavy reliance on private banks and energy left the portfolio exposed to multiple simultaneous large-cap corrections.
portfolio.line: A large-cap portfolio concentrated in top private sector financials, energy leaders, and IT exporters.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank fell 14.27% over 3 months amid foreign institutional selling, generating an estimated -1.347% contribution drag.
Mahindra & Mahindra fell 10.65% over the same span, contributing an estimated -0.537% negative return.
Reliance Industries dropped 10.51% over 3 months, contributing an estimated -0.429% drag to fund value.

themes.text: Exposure targeted toward domestic and export industrial buildouts and refining capacities.

macro.why: Potential rate hikes and loan growth trends directly influence net interest margins and credit costs.
Administrative suspensions of US green card application procedures disrupt offshore-onsite staffing dynamics.

FII stake reduction of 2.4% in HDFC Bank during the quarter ending September 2026.

could_change.title: Leadership Overhaul at HDFC Bank
could_change.text: The induction of Anup Bagchi as MD & CEO starting October 27, 2026 could influence operational strategy and deposit gathering.

could_change.title: Regulatory Actions in Healthcare
could_change.text: Reversal or legal relief regarding the Maharashtra FDA's Pune warehouse licence cancellation could stabilize Cipla's supply chain.
